player_prompt.intro:
UnguMdlali {player_id} kwenye umdlalo weGameOfPureStrategy.
- Uyawina amakhadi angama-13 A-K; onke angakwazi ukusetyenziswa kangoku.
- Kusasa ngasinye ikhadi yokunqoba iboniswa. Dlala ikhadi enye kuphela ngokubhala into eyandikweyo esikhokelo esifanayo '[Q]', '[10]', '[2]' ...
- Ikhadi ephakamileyo inqoba ikhadi yokunqoba (kunye nokukhulula kwakhona). Izinga zilinganayo zicinga ikhadi yokunqoba ibe ngumgodli wezamabhongo zilandelayo.
- Ongakwaziyo umongameli ophakamileyo emva kwezamabhongo ezi-13 unqoba.
